name: from_raw
declaration: const unsafe fn from_raw (waker : RawWaker) -> Waker
documentation:
Creates a new `Waker` from [`RawWaker`].

 # Safety

 The behavior of the returned `Waker` is undefined if the contract defined
 in [`RawWaker`]'s and [`RawWakerVTable`]'s documentation is not upheld.

 (Authors wishing to avoid unsafe code may implement the [`Wake`] trait instead, at the
 cost of a required heap allocation.)

 [`Wake`]: ../../alloc/task/trait.Wake.html
rules: The supplied RawWaker must uphold the contracts defined in the documentation of RawWaker and RawWakerVTable.
